# River by Asynarch

The cash book that writes itself. Upload your statement. See every payment recorded, in minutes.

## It just happens
Right now, someone opens an entry, picks who it's for, and saves it. One payment at a time. Upload your statement instead, and it's done in minutes.

## How it works
1. Upload your statement.
2. River writes down each payment. Who it's with, in plain words.
3. Your cash book is ready. In minutes.

## Every evening
Upload today's statement before you go home. In a few minutes, every payment from today is recorded and ready.

## It learns, once
Most payments, River understands right away. When one isn't obvious, it simply asks who the payment is with. Tell it once. River remembers, and never asks again.

## Why this matters
A business isn't a set of accounts. It's people. The ones who pay you, and the ones you pay. River keeps your books that way, because that's how you already think about your business.

## The horizon
This is the first page. River's next job is to know your business the way you do.
